Game Overview

In Merge Gun FPS Shooting Zombie, the core idea is straightforward: mow down waves of undead with strategic prowess in Merge Gun FPS Shooting Zombie. Merge identical firearms to forge mightier weapons, and use explosive elements to manage overwhelming hordes. This first-person shooter challenges your reflexes and tactical acumen amid relentless attacks from zombies and crows. Stay sharp and keep moving!
